//: Runtime build config. Compiles the readable engine in src/ down onto the legacy runnable layout at scripts/ (no dist). Used at cutover (Step 7); during the alongside phase we validate with `npm run typecheck` + tsx. Note: emitting the exact legacy `.cjs` entry names (scripts/hook-runtime.cjs, scripts/cursor-hook-runtime.cjs, scripts/<runner>.cjs) is finalized at cutover — tsc emits .js, so the entry files are authored as .cts (→ .cjs) while internals emit .js and are resolved by extensionless require.
